description: This file implements sensing client management and CSI monitoring functionalities for a radio device, including adding, removing, updating clients, handling sensing statistics, and enabling/disabling sensing features.

classes.name: wld_csiClient_t
classes.description: Structure representing a CSI sensing client, including MAC address, monitoring interval, and linked list iterator.

methods.name: s_findClientByMacFromTemplate
methods.description: Finds a client object by MAC address from a template object.

methods.name: wld_sensing_findClientByMac
methods.description: Finds a sensing client by MAC address within a radio's client list.

methods.name: s_updateClient
methods.description: Adds or updates a client in the sensing system via driver callback.

methods.name: s_removeClient
methods.description: Removes a client from the sensing system via driver callback.

methods.name: s_clientMACAddressIsValid
methods.description: Validates a MAC address string and converts it to standard format.

methods.name: _Sensing_addClient
methods.description: Adds a new sensing client with specified MAC address and monitoring interval.

methods.name: _wld_wifiSensing_addClientInst_oaf
methods.description: Creates a new client instance in the data model and registers it.

methods.name: _wld_wifiSensing_setMonitorInterval_pwf
methods.description: Updates the monitoring interval for a sensing client.

methods.name: _Sensing_delClient
methods.description: Deletes a sensing client with specified MAC address.

methods.name: wld_sensing_delCsiClientEntry
methods.description: Deletes a CSI client entry from the data model.

methods.name: _wld_wifiSensing_delClient_odf
methods.description: Handles destruction of a client instance, removing it from the system.

methods.name: _Sensing_debug
methods.description: Debug function to list all sensing clients.

methods.name: wld_sensing_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up the sensing client list.
